verdict.rationale: First-party docs and code show the core promise delivered: any URL or PDF/Office doc becomes clean Markdown/JSON via a headless-Chrome + curl engine selection, with anti-bot proxy rotation and cookie/session support handling blocking, and explicit positioning against 'unreliable' raw scraping (docs-2, gh-1, gh-9, gh-16, gh-3, docs-1). Additional controls (frontmatter, token limits, chunking, image captioning) reinforce LLM-readiness. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks validating output cleanliness at scale, and some community reports of 404/auth errors suggest occasional real-world friction (comm-3, comm-4, comm-5).
